You are an investment analyst preparing a quarterly stock comparison report. Your workspace contains no pre-existing files for this task.

Connect to the Yahoo Finance data source and retrieve the stock information for all available tracked stocks. You need the current price, analyst recommendation, sector, and company name for each stock.

Create a Word document called Stock_Comparison_Report.docx in your workspace. The document should have a title "Stock Comparison Report" at the top. Include a section called "Stock Overview" that contains a table with the following columns: Symbol, Company_Name, Current_Price, Analyst_Recommendation, Sector. The table should contain one row for each of the five tracked stocks: GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, and XOM, populated with the data you retrieved from Yahoo Finance. After the table, include a section called "Analysis" with written commentary comparing the stocks, noting which have strong buy versus buy recommendations and discussing the sector diversity. Finally, add a section called "Portfolio Strategy" with your recommendations based on the analyst ratings.

Schedule a Google Calendar event called "Portfolio Review Meeting" on April 10, 2026 from 14:00 to 15:30. Include a brief description mentioning the five stocks being reviewed. Use the America/New_York timezone for all calendar events in this task.

Send an email to analyst@investment.com with subject "Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026" and attach or reference the Stock_Comparison_Report.docx you created. The email body should summarize the key findings from your analysis.

When you are finished creating the document, scheduling the calendar event, and sending the email, call claim_done.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Issue the five `get_stock_info` calls for GOOGL, AMZN, JPM, JNJ, and XOM and the exact-event lookup as native-parallel calls. Freeze only Symbol, Company_Name from the returned long name, Current_Price, Analyst_Recommendation, and Sector. Create `Stock_Comparison_Report.docx` once with the exact title, five-row table, Analysis, and Portfolio Strategy, using one bulk structured content write followed by one read-back. Independently create only a missing `Portfolio Review Meeting` at 2026-04-10 14:00–15:30 America/New_York and verify it by ID. Finally send exactly one email to `analyst@investment.com` with subject `Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026`, reference or attach the verified document, and call `claim_done`.

Create a Word document at this exact path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_[REDACTED]/SingleUserTurn-yf-stock-comparison-word-gcal/workspace/Stock_Comparison_Report.docx

The document must have the following structure:

1. Title paragraph: "Stock Comparison Report" (Heading 1 or large bold title)

2. Section heading: "Stock Overview" (Heading 2)
   Followed by a 6-column, 6-row table (1 header row + 5 data rows):
   Header row: Symbol | Company_Name | Current_Price | Analyst_Recommendation | Sector
   
   Data rows (exactly as specified):
   Row 1: GOOGL | Alphabet Inc. | $300.88 | Strong Buy | Communication Services
   Row 2: AMZN | Amazon.com, Inc. | $218.94 | Strong Buy | Consumer Cyclical
   Row 3: JPM | JPMorgan Chase & Co. | $293.55 | Buy | Financial Services
   Row 4: JNJ | Johnson & Johnson | $239.63 | Buy | Healthcare
   Row 5: XOM | Exxon Mobil Corporation | $150.76 | Buy | Energy

3. Section heading: "Analysis" (Heading 2)
   Followed by a paragraph of written commentary (~150-200 words) that:
   - Notes that GOOGL and AMZN carry Strong Buy ratings (the two highest-conviction picks among the five)
   - Notes that JPM, JNJ, and XOM carry Buy ratings
   - Discusses sector diversity: the portfolio spans Communication Services (GOOGL), Consumer Cyclical (AMZN), Financial Services (JPM), Healthcare (JNJ), and Energy (XOM)
   - Comments briefly on the breadth of market cap and industry exposure this provides

4. Section heading: "Portfolio Strategy" (Heading 2)
   Followed by a paragraph (~100-150 words) with investment recommendations based on analyst ratings:
   - Recommend overweighting GOOGL and AMZN given Strong Buy consensus
   - Suggest maintaining balanced exposure to the Buy-rated names for diversification
   - Note that XOM's Buy rating with energy sector exposure provides inflation hedging
   - Mention that JNJ provides defensive healthcare exposure and JPM gives financial-sector leverage

Use the mcp__word__* tools available in your context. Create the document, add the title, add the heading and table, format the table (header row highlighted, alternating row colors), then add the Analysis and Portfolio Strategy sections.

Return: "Document created successfully at /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_[REDACTED]/SingleUserTurn-yf-stock-comparison-word-gcal/workspace/Stock_Comparison_Report.docx" when done.

You need to complete two external write actions: (1) create a Google Calendar event, and (2) send an email.

## Action 1: Google Calendar Event

Create a calendar event with these exact details:
- Title: "Portfolio Review Meeting"
- Start: 2026-04-10T14:00:00 (America/New_York timezone)
- End: 2026-04-10T15:30:00 (America/New_York timezone)
- Description: "Quarterly portfolio review covering five tracked stocks: GOOGL (Alphabet), AMZN (Amazon), JPM (JPMorgan Chase), JNJ (Johnson & Johnson), and XOM (Exxon Mobil). Review analyst recommendations, sector allocation, and portfolio strategy adjustments for Q2 2026."

## Action 2: Send Email

Send an email using mcp__emails__send_email with:
- to: "analyst@investment.com"
- subject: "Stock Comparison Report - Q2 2026"
- body: (use the text below exactly)

---
Dear Analyst,

Please find attached the Stock Comparison Report for Q2 2026, covering five tracked equities across diverse sectors.

Key findings from our analysis:

1. Strong Buy Picks: GOOGL (Alphabet, $300.88, Communication Services) and AMZN (Amazon, $218.94, Consumer Cyclical) both carry Strong Buy consensus ratings — AMZN with a mean score of 1.3 and GOOGL at 1.4 — making them the highest-conviction positions in this portfolio.

2. Buy-Rated Holdings: JPM (JPMorgan Chase, $293.55, Financial Services), JNJ (Johnson & Johnson, $239.63, Healthcare), and XOM (Exxon Mobil, $150.76, Energy) all carry Buy recommendations, providing well-diversified exposure across three additional sectors.

3. Sector Diversity: The five-stock portfolio spans Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Energy — offering broad market exposure and reducing concentration risk.

4. Portfolio Strategy: We recommend overweighting GOOGL and AMZN given their Strong Buy consensus, while maintaining balanced positions in JPM, JNJ, and XOM for diversification. XOM's energy exposure also serves as an inflation hedge.

The full Stock_Comparison_Report.docx has been prepared and is available for your review.

Best regards,
Investment Analysis Team
---
